Embryo Explorer

A sculptural study of embryonic form, built from original procedural geometry. The three forms are conceptual stages, not reconstructions of particular specimens or exact developmental dates.

The internal structures are simplified illustrations. Particles sample their surfaces; they do not represent measured cells. This is an educational visualization, not a predictive or diagnostic model.

Geometry, interface, and camera choreography created for this project. Rendering uses Three.js, licensed under MIT.
